honesty_notes: This proves BMS-visible coordinator/child launch, strict backend propagation, and real PairformerNoSeq CUDA workhorse bundle execution for a tiny n=6 fixture.

The plan uses logical 2x2 bundles while physical_launch_size_cp remains 1 on cuda:0; this is deliberate single-GPU workhorse cadence, not multi-rank distributed CP.
